summary: National Grid plc furnished a routine Form 6-K carrying three London Stock Exchange announcements dated early September 2026. Exhibit 99.1 is a monthly Total Voting Rights update: registered capital of 5,249,831,589 ordinary shares, 222,997,408 held in treasury, leaving 5,026,834,181 voting rights for FCA disclosure denominators. Exhibits 99.2 and 99.3 are MAR Article 19 PDMR notifications — a non-executive director's open-market purchase of 2,507 American Depositary Shares at about USD 79.84 on 28 August 2026, and an LTPP buyout award vesting in three tranches. No special situation, no deal terms, no board recommendation.
